summary: Verified SA CoParents Align frontend repositioning end-to-end. Landing / auth / dashboard / hub / resources / sample / privacy pages all render correctly. Full professional cycle validated: register pro (role=professional confirmed via /api/auth/me) -> /joint/new -> subject -> child -> parent A/B invitations with private case reference -> pro-case-code SA-COM-812609 + two parent share links. Parent flow: Join.jsx -> auth register produces role=parent with parent-invite-note; both parents completed the assessment. Pro dashboard exposed 'Generate Report' -> report page shows joint-case-code AND joint-case-ref (private), Download PDF button visible. Parent restrictions verified: /hub redirects to /dashboard; parent dashboard has no create-joint-report-btn, no circle-nav-section, no agreement-card; shows parent-joint-note + invitation-code-input; joint-case-ref not present on parent's dashboard listing. No 'Get Started' language on landing or sample pages. Browser tab title is 'SA CoParents Align | Professional Joint Reports'. All specified data-testids resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx (~415 lines) is close to the 700-line file-size threshold but still acceptable; consider extracting SUBJECTS/CLARITY_POINTS/APPLICATIONS data + subject-card sub-component if it grows further.

Dashboard.jsx is ~465 lines and contains many independent responsibilities (individual link, joint tools, agreement, family-violence request, invitation code entry, joint list, shared list, pro-requests, legacy assessments). It reads fine but would benefit from extracting these into subcomponents for maintainability.

Auth.jsx derives isParentFlow purely from ?next=/join/<token>. If a valid registered professional email is used with a parent invite link, the account is still created as parent — backend gating (invite matches email) is the only guard. This is by design per spec but worth noting.
test_credentials: Freshly registered per run (pro_<rnd>@testmail.com / TestPass123!, pa_<rnd>@testmail.com & pb_<rnd>@testmail.com / ParentPass1!). Admin credentials in /app/memory/test_credentials.md were NOT used per the request note.
seed_data_creation: None persistent beyond newly created test accounts + one joint report (SA-COM-812609) for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend repositioning is confirmed working. Subject key in /api/joint/config is 'communication' (not 'general'). Parent register after clicking join-register-btn lands back at /join/<token>; the user then clicks accept-invitation-btn to reach /joint/<id>/assess. Assessment completion is achieved by iterating: fill any empty textareas, auto-check first radio in each unchecked group, click Submit/Next/Continue button until URL leaves /assess.
